parameters.content:
CEKIVA social publishing — n8n template

SETUP (once)
1. Credentials → create two "Header Auth" credentials:
   • "CEKIVA API key"  — Name: Authorization   Value: Bearer tplk_...  (create the key in CEKIVA: Settings → API keys)
   • "CEKIVA webhook secret" — Name: X-Webhook-Secret   Value: a long random string (callers must send it)
2. Open each node that shows a red credential warning and pick the credential.
3. Config node: set cekiva_base_url (default https://cekiva.com/api/v1).
4. Activate the workflow.

CALL
POST <your n8n>/webhook/cekiva-publish   header X-Webhook-Secret: <secret>
{ "text": "Hello", "platforms": ["linkedin","bluesky"],
  "media_urls": ["https://.../image.jpg"],          (optional)
  "workspace_id": "<client workspace UUID>",        (optional; default = your primary workspace)
  "scheduled_at": "2026-12-01T09:00:00Z" }          (optional; omitted = publish right away)
Optional flags: require_approval (client approves first), ai_generated (TikTok AI label).

ANSWER
200 {"status":"SUCCESS","post_ids":[...],"posts":[...]}
4xx/5xx {"status":"ERROR","error":{"kind","code","message","hint","stage","upstream_status"}}
  kind = coarse class, code = CEKIVA's error code (INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS, SCHEDULE_TIME_PAST, ...): both UPPERCASE and stable.

NOTES
• Supported platforms: linkedin, tiktok, youtube, pinterest, bluesky, discord, facebook_page, instagram, threads, facebook_reels.
• Every post costs credits when scheduled (the workspace owner pays). A repeated call creates a second post: there is no idempotency key.
• "message" and "hint" are CEKIVA's own words in English (the HTTP nodes send Accept-Language: en); branch on "code" / "kind" or the HTTP status, not on the text.
